Two-Story Modular House with Garage

The Two-Story Modular House with Garage is a modern prefab home designed for families, private developers, and vacation property owners. Combining comfortable living space with an integrated garage and rooftop terrace, this modular home offers an efficient solution for permanent residences, holiday homes, rental properties, and residential developments.

Factory-built using durable steel structures and insulated sandwich panels, the prefab modular house can be customized in layout and finishes to meet different project requirements while reducing on-site construction time. Suitable for both permanent and temporary residential projects, the design combines fast construction, flexible customization, and long-term durability.

Why Choose This Two-Story Modular House with Garage

Spacious Two-Story Layout: The two-story design separates shared living areas from private bedrooms, creating a comfortable and practical home for families.

Integrated Garage: The enclosed garage provides secure vehicle parking and convenient storage for daily use.

Rooftop Terrace: A spacious rooftop terrace extends the outdoor living area and is ideal for relaxation, family gatherings, or entertaining guests.

Durable Modular Construction: Built with a galvanized steel frame and insulated sandwich panels, it offers long-lasting durability, structural stability, and sustainability.

Fast Installation: Factory-prefabricated components reduce on-site construction time and help accelerate overall project completion.

Customizable Design: This two-story modular house can be customized from the overall size and floor plan to the exterior appearance, interior finishes, garage layout, and electrical and plumbing systems.

Whether you require a private residence, vacation home, rental unit, or customized housing project, the NEW BRAND modular home can be tailored to match your functional and aesthetic needs.

Applications of the Two-Story Modular House with Garage

Permanent Family Residence: Designed for comfortable daily living with separate private and public spaces.

Vacation Home: Suitable for lakeside, mountain, coastal, or countryside holiday properties.

Rental Property: An attractive solution for short-term or long-term rental investment projects.

Resort Villa: Can be integrated into resorts, eco-tourism destinations, and hospitality developments.

Staff Accommodation: Provides comfortable residential housing for management staff and long-term employees.

Residential Development: Suitable for modular housing communities and residential construction projects requiring rapid delivery.

Frequently Asked Questions

1
Can This Modular House Be Used as a Permanent Residence?
Yes. This modular house is designed for long-term residential use. It can be configured to meet local building codes and climate requirements, making it suitable for permanent homes, vacation properties, and residential developments.
2
Does This Modular House Require a Concrete Foundation?
Foundation requirements depend on the installation site, soil conditions, and local regulations. In most cases, a reinforced concrete foundation is recommended to ensure structural stability and long-term performance.
3
Can This Modular House Comply with Local Building Regulations?
Yes. NEW BRAND can customize the structural design, insulation system, and building specifications to help meet local building codes and project requirements. Customers should confirm the applicable regulations with local authorities before installation.
4
What Is Included in the Standard Modular House Package?
The standard package typically includes the galvanized steel structure, insulated wall and roof panels, doors, windows, flooring, and basic structural components. Interior finishes, kitchens, bathrooms, electrical systems, plumbing, and other optional features can be configured based on project requirements.
5
Do I Need Local Contractors for Installation?
NEW BRAND provides detailed installation technical documentation and remote engineering support to help ensure a smooth installation process. On-site technical assistance can also be arranged for selected projects when required.
6
How Is the Modular House Delivered?
Depending on the project size and design, the modular house can be delivered in flat-pack or modular form to optimize container loading efficiency and reduce transportation costs. Packaging methods are arranged according to the destination and project requirements.
7
What Information Is Required to Receive a Quotation?
To provide an accurate quotation, please share your project location, required quantity, preferred floor plan, customization requirements, and any applicable local building standards. Our engineering team will recommend a suitable solution based on your project needs.
